title: A Brand New Note 📝
excerpt: This might just be one of our fastest releases yet! Right after version 1.9, we're introducing Friend Notes, bringing back Block History, adding direct unblocking, and delivering a bunch of bug fixes and popup UI improvements.
body:
This might just be one of our fastest releases yet! Right after our previous update, version 1.9, we went straight back into development and started working on even more improvements.

Introducing Friend Notes! You can now add notes to your friends so you can remember why they're your friend, who they are, or anything else you want to remember about them. Notes are saved to our servers and can be accessed directly from Compact Viewer or Friends Details.

Introducing Block History! The return of Block History is here! You can now view your blocked users directly from the popup, with Block History using its own separate database. You can also unblock users directly from Block History.

We've also fixed several bugs, made a few popup changes, and improved the UI across Friends Remover to make everything feel cleaner and smoother.

We've also added Show Background in PFPs, allowing you to display a user's selected Roblox Avatar Background behind their avatar. This feature is enabled by default.

The popup has also been made slightly bigger to give the interface more room, while the outlines around trusted and pinned users have been removed for a cleaner look.

We've also moved Mutual Mode to appear before Block Mode in the popup, making the layout more organized and easier to navigate.

And that's just the start.

added.moreInfo: You can now add notes to your friends so you can remember who they are, why they're your friend, or anything else you want to remember. Notes are saved to our servers and can be accessed directly from Compact Viewer or Friends Details.
Block History is back! You can now view your blocked users directly from the popup using a dedicated Block History system with its own separate database.
You can now unblock users directly from Block History.
You can now display a user's selected Roblox Avatar Background behind their avatar. This feature is enabled by default.
Friends are now cached with their original friends-since date for better friend information and data handling.
Added dedicated history icons in the popup and Settings instead of using emoji icons.
The uninstall system can now detect and collect errors along with the user's friend count to help identify issues.

added.text: Block Mode Is Free for a Limited Time
added.moreInfo: Block Mode is now completely free for all users for a LIMITED TIME. Try it out before the promotion ends!
Updated the Mutual Mode removal screen and added the user's friend count to make the removal experience clearer.

removed.moreInfo: Removed the broken reCAPTCHA verification system from Settings.
Removed the outlines around trusted and pinned users for a cleaner and more minimal interface.

fixed.moreInfo: Fixed an issue where dismissing a user would still show them.
Fixed certain systems not properly respecting the 'Receive Notifications' setting.
Fixed headshots failing to load properly after switching popup view types.
Fixed pinned and trusted users being able to get removed through Mutual Mode.
Fixed the removal button not updating to 'Remove (count)' when Mutual Mode was enabled in Compact Viewer.
Fixed headshots flashing or displaying incorrectly on the removal screen.
Fixed searching in Compact Viewer causing the 'No Friends Found' error.
Added proper Dark Mode support to error messages and fixed messages that were difficult to read.
Fixed certain texts becoming unreadable depending on the selected theme when Dark Mode was enabled.
Fixed the 'Switched to Friends List' toast appearing too high on the screen.

improved.moreInfo: Slightly increased the popup size to give the interface more room and make it more comfortable to use.
Made several UI improvements throughout the popup to create a cleaner, smoother, and more polished experience.
Moved Mutual Mode to appear before Block Mode in the popup for a more organized and intuitive layout.
Made the popup loading screen more descriptive so users have a better idea of what is happening while the extension loads.
The popup view-switching button now uses an icon that correctly corresponds with the currently selected view.
Improved Mutual Mode protection so pinned and trusted users cannot accidentally be removed.
Fixed popup lag and improved how smoothly the popup responds during normal use.
Friend data is now cached with the friends-since date for better data handling.
Added special custom history icons throughout the popup and Settings for a cleaner and more consistent interface.
Improved error detection and handling across multiple extension systems.
Uninstall feedback now provides useful diagnostic information that can help identify bugs users experienced before uninstalling.
Updated the removal screen to display the user's friend count and provide a clearer progress experience.
